Commentary.Commentary: We are back! The Zimbabwe players are out there in the middle. Steven Taylor and Monank Patel are the openers for USA. Richard Ngarava will start with the ball for Zimbabwe. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

The USA bowlers bowled well until Raza came to the wicket. The likes of Steven Taylor, Nisarg Patel and Saurabh Netravalkar were really good but they had no answers to the onslaught of Raza. They leaked far too many runs in the end and the last over probably has taken the game away from them. If USA does manage to chase it down, it is going to be some effort from them. Zimbabwe on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. The wicket is slightly on the slower side. Can USA get to the target? We shall find out. Stay tuned for the run-chase.

Sikandar Raza seemed like he was batting on a different wicket. All the others struggled to get going but he scored boundaries at will and quite easily was the highlight of this innings. He scored almost half of his side’s score and this is going to be a tough chase for USA. There was a decent contribution from Sean Williams but it was Raza who seal the show with his fantastic hitting.

That innings from Raza could well be the one which wins Zimbabwe the game. Had it not been for him, Zimbabwe would have ended up with something around 150 but he has taken his side to a score which we believe is well over par.

Two to finish this very expensive last over! 26 from it! This is fuller and around off. Milton Shumba drills it wide of long off and comes back for the second run. Zimbabwe finish with 185/6 after 20 overs!
FOUR! Milton Shumba gets into the act now! This is tossed up on off. Shumba gets under it and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary.
A full delivery on off. Raza heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Jones goes 'round the wicket and it is way outside off. Raza leaves it alone.

SIX! Three in a row now! Raza is taking his team to a very good score here! Jones with a full-length delivery on off. Raza just stays deep in his crease again and launches it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
SIX! That is massive! This was always going to be a gamble to bowl a spinner in the last over and Raza is cashing in now. A fuller delivery, around off. Raza smokes it over long on for biggie.
SIX! Raza starts the final over with a biggie! This is pushed quicker on middle. Raza stays in his crease, gets under it and slams it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Aaron Jones will bowl the last over!
In the blockhole again, outside off. Sikandar Raza knocks it to point for a single. He will keep the strike for the last over.
Gets the yorker right once again on middle, Milton Shumba digs it to long on for a single.
Milton Shumba walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED! Brilliant over so far from Saurabh Netravalkar! He bowls it full on middle from 'round the wicket. Luke Jongwe goes for a big swing across the line but misses. The ball shatters the stumps and USA have pulled things back in the last couple of overs.
A yorker, on middle. Raza only manages to dig it out to long on for a single.
A very full delivery on off. Luke Jongwe slogs but does so without much timing to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Raza drills it to long off for a single.
Luke Jongwe is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in the over for Aaron Jones! This is tossed up, around off. Burl tries to fetch it from outside off and looks to slog it away. However, he gets a huge top edge and the ball goes high in the air. The USA skipper, Monank Patel settles under it to take an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Monank Patel b Aaron Jones

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Clean-hit this time!
In the air...but safe! Tossed up on off. Burl looks to slog-sweep but gets a huge top edge. The ball goes in the air but falls short of the long off fielder. A couple of runs taken.
On the shorter side on off, Raza punches it to covers for a single.
Goes fuller and outside off. Raza drives it wide of long off for a couple.
Ryan Burl is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! So, the move to bring Aaron Jones into the attack has worked here.  This is tossed up, around off. Sean Williams dances down the track and looks to go big down the ground. However, he does not get the distance and ends up hitting it straight to Gajanand Singh at long off. He takes a fine catch and USA finally break this dangerous partnership.
Commentary.Howout: c Gajanand Singh b Aaron Jones

Commentary.Commentary: Aaron Jones is brought into the attack now.
A length delivery on middle. Sean Williams works it past square leg for a single.
Goes fuller and outside off. Raza drills it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! He continues to find boundaries here! On a length, on middle. Raza paddles it aerially towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Fifty for Sikandar Raza! Another fantastic knock from this talented all-rounder. He looked comfortable right from the time go and has now raced away to fifty in a pretty quick time. It is full on off. Raza flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Better from Theron! Bowls a cutter on off. Raza blocks it out.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Juan Theron starts his new spell with a short delivery, outside off. Raza waits for it and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Juan Theron is back on.
On a length and outside off, Sikandar Raza pushes it through covers for a single. 13 runs from the over.
FOUR! Poor from Saurabh Netravalkar. This is full and down the leg, Sikandar Raza just tickles it past the keeper towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Full and on middle, Sean Williams works it to long on for a single.

CLOSE! Good-length delivery outside off, nipping back in a bit. Sikandar Raza goes on his back foot and tries to cut it but misses and the ball just goes past the off pole. The keeper could not collect it and they run a bye.
SIX! That is huge. Saurabh Netravalkar goes for the off cutter but lands it back of length on middle. Sikandar Raza picks up the length early and smokes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Bowls it full and down the leg, Sikandar Raza misses his flick and get hits on his pads.

FOUR! Misfield allows another boundary, 16 from the over! Short and wide outside off. Sean Williams cuts it towards deep point. Steven Taylor in the deep runs across to his right and slides to stop it. However, the ball goes past him and crosses the fence.
Back of a length, around off. Raza punches it to covers for a single.
On the shorter side on middle. Raza pulls it aerially towards the fine leg region. The fielder there Nisarg Patel runs across to his left and stops it off the bounce. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries now! Goes fuller and around off. Raza backs away a bit this time and slaps it towards the extra-cover fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Clever from Raza! A fullish delivery, around off. Raza gets a bit across and scoops it towards the fine leg fence.
Shorter and outside off. Sean Williams cuts it towards covers. The fielder there dives to his right and keeps it to just a single.
A dot to end. Outside off, this is cut to point.
This is hit down to long on for another single.
Outside off, shorter, this is cut through point for one.
Fires it on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit back to the bowler.
On middle, blocked out.
Tossed up on off, turning away a bit. Williams tries to cut it but plays over the ball and it goes past his inside edge.
Floated on middle and leg, Raza drives it through mid on for a single.
Fractionally short and on middle, Raza goes back in his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. There is a wobble in the deep and they get two runs.
Tossed up on middle, Williams goes down and sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Bowls it quicker and on middle, Williams flicks it with soft hands through square leg. and picks up a brace
SIX! That should break the shackles! All the way. Raza gets a chance to free his arms and it clears the fence. This is full and on off, it is lofted over the cover fence for a biggie.
Dealing in singles at the moment! On the off pole, Williams pushes it on the off side for one.
Angled into the pads, Raza flicks it through square leg and takes one.
Another loud shout, the bowler can't believe that has not been given! Fuller on the pads, Williams looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken.
Fractionally short, zips through, Raza looks to pull but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! This one is down the leg side. Raza looks to flick but misses. Wided.
A huge shout but not given again! Maybe another inside edge! On the pads, Williams looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Cameron Stevenson is back on. One over for four runs and a wicket so far.
FOUR! This is short and on middle, Raza pulls it hard towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
On middle, blocked out.
Tossed up outside off, Williams drills it towards long off for a single.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Raza pushes it to the leg side for one.
Darted in on middle, Williams works it through square leg for a single.
Floated on off, Raza flicks through mid-wicket for one.
Steven Taylor is back on.
Two more! The sweep is out and it is played through mid-wicket for a couple.
On middle, Raza works it through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Good stop! This is fuller and on off, it is hit back towards the bowler who dives to his right and stops it well.
Shorter and on off, Raza pushes it through covers for one more.
Flatter and on off, Raza plays it back to the bowler.
Angled into the middle pole, this is flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Sikandar Raza is the next man in.

OUT! THIS TIME THE FINGER IS RAISED! USA now have three and Zimbabwe now in a spot of bother! Shorter and on middle, Kaia looks to pull but misses. It hits him high on the pads. A huge appeal and the finger goes up. The height could have been an issue.
Good length and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On middle, length, it is played back to the bowler.

A huge appeal but turned down! Probably the umpire felt there was an inside edge! Length and outside off, this one jags back in. Kaia looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls down to third man for one.
Shorter in length and outside off, this one stays a touch low. Williams looks to pull, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
Another single as Williams strokes it through covers.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter in length and around off, a little bit of turn away. Kaia looks to cut but is beaten.
On the stumps, this is played back to the bowler.
Innocent Kaia walks out at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! USA have another one! Regis Chakabva, who was looking dangerous falls, shorter and outside off. Chakabva goes back and looks to lift it over covers but holes out to the fielder in the ring, Gajanand Singh. He failed to get the elevation he wanted and falls in the process.
Commentary.Howout: c Gajanand Singh b Nisarg Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly shorter in length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
A single to end another tidy over from Taylor! On off, this is hit through covers for one.
On the pads, this is swept but to short fine leg.
Another single as this is pushed through covers.
On off, Regis Chakabva pushes it towards cover for one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Angled into the pads, Williams looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

Dropped! Slower fullish delivery, around off. Sean Williams hits it aerially towards right of the bowler. Juan Theron looks to catch it on his follow through but fails to hold onto this one. A single taken.
Back of a length, around off. Regis Chakabva punches it towards cover-point. The fielder at point dives and half-stops it. A single taken.
Goes fuller on off. Sean Williams drives it wide of mid off for a single.
FOUR! Sean Williams gets another boundary! On the shorter side, around off. Sean Williams rocks back and pulls it towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Sean Williams pushes it to cover-point.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Shorter in length and outside off. Sean Williams slaps it through covers and beats the diving fielder in that region for a boundary.
Goes a bit fuller on off. Regis Chakabva drives it wide of long off for a couple.
Pushed quicker on off. Regis Chakabva defends it out.
Goes fuller on middle. Sean Williams works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air on off. Sean Williams looks to paddle it but misses and gets hit on the pads. The impact it outside off though.
Goes fuller on middle. Regis Chakabva clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting on the pads. Sean Williams works it to square leg for a single.
Serves It fuller and outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to drive it away but misses.
FOUR! Short and punished! This is shorter in length and outside off. Regis Chakabva cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! Regis Chakabva continues to show aggression! On a length, on off. Regis Chakabva stays deep in his crease and heaves it wide of long on for a boundary.
Lands on a length, on middle. Sean Williams works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Sean Williams is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nisarg Patel gets a big wicket! This is fuller on off. Craig Ervine paddles it towards short fine leg. However, he does that aerially and Saurabh Netravalkar takes a brilliant catch diving forward. USA have got an early wicket here.
Commentary.Howout: c Saurabh Netravalkar b Nisarg Patel

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nice and fine! The reverse sweep is played really well! Outside off, this is swept fine on the off side and this one races away to the fence.
Back of a length, on middle. Ervine works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Lands on a length, on off. Ervine picks the length quickly and heave it towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Serves a length ball, around off. Ervine gets a bit across and looks to paddle it away. He misses and the ball goes off his pads towards the leg side. Ervine looks for a single but is sent back.
Goes a bit fuller and on middle again. Regis Chakabva nudges it to mid-wicket for another single.
Lands on a length, on middle. Ervine works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Regis Chakabva looks to punch it away. He does so without much timing to mid off. A single taken.
Juan Theron with a good bouncer on middle. Craig Ervine ducks under it. Good start so far for Zimbabwe!
Back of a length, on leg. Regis Chakabva looks to clip it away but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Regis Chakabva is in the mood today! Short and wide outside off. Regis Chakabva cuts it through point for another boundary.
SIX! Smashed! Lands on a length, on off. Regis Chakabva dances down the track and launches it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Nicely played! A fuller delivery on off. Regis Chakabva moves a bit across and scoops it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Shorter in length and outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to cut but misses.
Juan Theron to start from the other end.

On the shorter side on middle and leg. Regis Chakabva looks to pull but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads and goes towards backward point. There is an appeal for an LBW but it is too high and the batters take a leg bye.
Back of a length, around off. Regis Chakabva dabs it towards backward point.
Lands on a length, on middle. Regis Chakabva pushes it to mid on this time.
On a length and around off. Ervine just guides it towards third man and gets off the mark with a single.
Serves it on a good length and outside off. Craig Ervine leaves it alone.
Starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery on middle. Regis Chakabva works it wide of square leg for a single. Zimbabwe and Regis Chakabva are underway!
We are all set to begin! The USA players are out there in the middle. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine are the openers for Zimbabwe. Saurabh Netravalkar to start with the ball. Here we go...

USA (Unchanged Playing XI) - Steven Taylor, Monank Patel (C) (WK), Aaron Jones, Jaskaran Malhotra, Gajanand Singh, Sushant Modani, Marty Kain, Nisarg Patel, Cameron Stevenson, Saurabh Netravalkar, Juan Theron.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Sean Williams, Innocent Kaia (In place of Wesley Madhevere), Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Milton Shumba, Wellington Masakadza, Luke Jongwe, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava (In place of Tendai Chatara).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Zimbabwe. They have elected to BAT first.

Zimbabwe are playing at home and are surely one of the favourites to win the tournament along with the Dutch. They have won both of their games so far but were pushed hard by Jersey in the last game. The USA on the other hand, have been clinical in both their wins so far and have the firepower and all-round quality to challenge Zimbabwe here. Will they outclass the more fancied Zimbabwe unit and make a statement by topping their group? Or will Zimbabwe bring their A-game onto the table? Let’s find out. Toss and team news in a bit.
